title: Homework set: direct and inverse proportion
subject: Mathematics
unit: Spring 1: Revision cycle 1: Number, algebra, sequences, graphs
source: Written for mathematics/y11 lesson 68 (Complete the portal's proportion set (6 questions) and update your repair list.)
intro: 6 questions. Show your working. Mark it with the mark scheme and add any errors to your repair list.

questions.q: y is directly proportional to x. y = 18 when x = 4. Find y when x = 10.
y is directly proportional to x². y = 50 when x = 5. Find y when x = 7.
y is inversely proportional to x. y = 12 when x = 3. Find x when y = 9.
P is inversely proportional to √Q. P = 6 when Q = 4. Find P when Q = 36.
y is directly proportional to x³. x is doubled. What happens to y?
The time to fill a tank is inversely proportional to the number of pipes used. 3 pipes take 40 minutes. How long do 5 pipes take?
